def verify(x, y, l2, l0, M, cert):
    w = np.asarray(cert['weights'])
    p = len(w)
    leaves = cert['subcube_leaves']
    G = x.T @ x
    b = x.T @ y
    const = y @ y / 2
    assert w.shape == (x.shape[1],) and np.max(abs(w)) <= M + 1e-10
    f = np.linalg.norm(x @ w - y) ** 2 / 2 + l2 * (w @ w) / 2 + l0 * np.count_nonzero(abs(w) > 1e-08)
    assert abs(cert['objective'] - f) < 1e-08
    ids = np.arange(1 << p, dtype=np.int32)
    cover = np.zeros(len(ids), dtype=np.uint16)
    min_lb = np.inf
    diags = {}
    bits = 1 << np.arange(p)
    for leaf in leaves:
        assert all((len(leaf[k]) == p and all((type(v) is bool for v in leaf[k])) for k in ('fixed_zero', 'fixed_active')))
        z = np.asarray(leaf['fixed_zero'])
        a = np.asarray(leaf['fixed_active'])
        assert not np.any(z & a)
        mask = int(bits @ (z | a))
        active = int(bits @ a)
        free = (1 << p) - 1 ^ mask
        sub = np.array([0], dtype=np.int32)
        while free:
            bit = free & -free
            sub = np.r_[sub, sub | bit]
            free ^= bit
        cover[sub | active] += 1
        d = np.asarray(leaf['minorant_diagonal'])
        u = np.asarray(leaf['minorant_center'])
        key = tuple(d)
        if key not in diags:
            assert np.min(d) >= 0 and np.linalg.eigvalsh(G - np.diag(d))[0] >= -1e-08
            diags[key] = G - np.diag(d)
        B = diags[key]
        h = B @ u - b
        q = d + l2
        v = np.clip(-h / q, -M, M)
        part = l0 + h * v + q * v * v / 2
        lb = const - u @ B @ u / 2 + sum(part[a]) + sum(np.minimum(part[~(a | z)], 0))
        assert abs(lb - leaf['lb']) < 1e-08 * (1 + abs(lb))
        min_lb = min(min_lb, lb)
    assert np.all(cover == 1)
    gap = f - cert['certified_lower_bound']
    assert abs(cert['certified_lower_bound'] - min(min_lb, cert['objective'])) < 1e-08
    return (f, gap, len(leaves))

def fixture(seed, p, coupling, M):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    counts = rng.integers(22, 65, (5, 3))
    (c, s) = (np.repeat(np.arange(15), counts.ravel()) // 3, np.repeat(np.arange(15), counts.ravel()) % 3)
    N = len(c)
    T = rng.normal(size=(N, 8)) + s[:, None] * rng.normal(0, 0.25, (1, 8))
    R = rng.normal(size=(N, 18))
    shift = np.linspace(-1.8, 1.8, 5)[c]
    gain = np.linspace(0.55, 1.6, 5)[c]
    raw = shift[:, None] + gain[:, None] * T
    raw[rng.random(raw.shape) < 0.025] = np.nan
    R = shift[:, None] + gain[:, None] * R
    R[rng.random(R.shape) < 0.05] = np.nan
    phase = rng.uniform(-1.5, 1.5, (N, 2))
    ref = np.exp(1j * rng.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi, (N, 2)))
    signal = ref * np.exp(1j * phase)
    h = np.column_stack((np.ones(N), s == 1, s == 2, T, phase))
    theta = rng.normal(0, 0.35, 13)
    yy = h @ theta + rng.normal(0, 0.08, N)
    loc = rng.permutation(N)
    (cal, j) = (loc[110:], loc[:110])
    glitch = rng.choice(cal, round(0.12 * len(cal)), replace=False)
    yy[glitch] += np.clip(2.5 * rng.standard_cauchy(len(glitch)), -11, 11)
    X = rng.normal(size=(len(j), p))
    X += coupling * rng.normal(size=(len(j), 1))
    X /= np.linalg.norm(X, axis=0)
    sparse = np.zeros(p)
    sparse[:5] = np.minimum(M, 1.4) * np.array([1, -0.9, 1, -0.75, 0.85])
    yy[j] += X @ sparse
    st = dict(panel=dict(center_id=c, stratum=s, X_panel_raw=raw, controls=R), interferometry=dict(signal_phasor=signal, ref_phasor=ref), y_assay_raw=yy, calibration_indices=cal, stage3_indices=j, X_cand=X, lam2=0.045, lam0=0.085, M=M)
    return (st, T, theta)
